subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` API as the public native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents` completion-routing contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but it creates model-facing tool semantics, config defaults, and persisted routing behavior in message-delivery/session-state code where repository policy requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after current-head proof
options.body: Review and land this PR or an equivalent after current-head real-behavior proof confirms parent routing, default channel delivery, and configured per-agent/default routing.

options.title: Narrow to per-spawn first
options.body: Accept the model-facing per-call option but defer global and per-agent config defaults until upgrade and operator-policy implications are clearer.

options.title: Pause the public contract
options.body: Keep the callback workaround and hold or close this PR until maintainers choose a broader orchestration API direction.

recommendation.title: Accept after current-head proof
recommendation.body: Review and land this PR or an equivalent after current-head real-behavior proof confirms parent routing, default channel delivery, and configured per-agent/default routing.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest prior issue-review and recent session/subagent routing history for the public contract choice.
